title: Change a single day's schedule right from the Day view
summary: The Day view's A-Day/B-Day/No School badge is now a clickable card -- tap it to change just that one date's type, without opening the full Class Schedule Editor.

The picker also lets you tag the day with a special schedule (Short Day, Assembly Day, etc.) or pick "Custom" to override just that day's period times, leaving every other day using that schedule untouched.
A day with custom times now shows a small "Custom" tag on its card so it's obvious at a glance that it's been overridden.
